objective: Use a preregistered 2x2 inner-only factorial to test the frozen C1 bounded age residual, the fixed Hybrid Call+Cat objective, their compatibility, and any super-additive interaction.

relationship.known_results: IDEA-071 through IDEA-073 provide positive internal evidence for C1, while IDEA-066 found a positive average Hybrid Call+Cat effect that did not pass its split-stability gate.
relationship.scope: New-seed internal module screening on the same 111 cats and role system; not an independent-dataset confirmation.
relationship.positive_subthreshold_retention: All positive effects are retained and reported even when a preregistered gate fails.

pipeline_definitions.A0_C_call_only: Matched frozen-AST 768->128->3 control trained with call-level loss.
pipeline_definitions.A0_H_hybrid: The same A0 model and initialization trained with the fixed 0.5 call plus 0.5 cat objective.
pipeline_definitions.C1_C_call_only: Frozen IDEA-071 C1 20->60->128 bounded age residual trained with call-level loss.
pipeline_definitions.C1_H_hybrid: The same C1 model and initialization trained with the fixed 0.5 call plus 0.5 cat objective.

model.cat_probability: arithmetic mean of all call softmax probabilities belonging to the cat
model.call_weighting: inverse class frequency computed from training-role calls only; each batch loss is weighted sum divided by weight sum
model.cat_weighting: inverse class frequency computed from training-role cats only; each batch loss is weighted sum divided by weight sum
model.seed_derivation_rule: Read successive non-overlapping digest uint32 values in big-endian order, reduce modulo 10000, and skip values colliding with IDEA-065 through IDEA-073 base seeds. The first three eligible unique values are used.
model.initialization_fairness: Each call-only/hybrid pair has an identical initial state_dict; all four models share identical AST-trunk tensors and zero initial output perturbation, C1 call/hybrid age branches are identical, all initial logits match, and training RNG is reset after model construction.
model.loss_path_fairness: All pipelines compute and audit both call and cat losses from identical complete-cat batches; only the fixed total-loss coefficients differ.

fixed_training.ast_head: training-role standardized 768 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm, and dropout

aggregation.primary_metric_unit: Nine seed-by-repeat estimates per pipeline, each pooling four validation folds and then weighted equally.
aggregation.split_cell_unit: Twelve repeat-by-fold cells, each first averaged across the three base seeds.
aggregation.probability_quality_interaction_sign: CE and Brier use improvement differences, so positive means Hybrid improves probability quality more under C1 than under A0.
aggregation.descriptive_only: Thirty-six fold comparisons and 612 repeated animal occurrences per pipeline are descriptive and are not treated as independent observations.

gate.interpretation: C1 replication, Hybrid adoption, and super-additive synergy are separate tiers. Synergy does not independently authorize adoption, and adoption does not require synergy.
gate.pass_action: If the Hybrid adoption tier passes, freeze C1-H as the internal main candidate before external benchmarks; otherwise retain C1-C. Claim super-additive synergy only if its separate tier passes.
gate.fail_action: Report and retain all positive simple effects even when a tier fails, without changing the C1 formula, Hybrid coefficients, seeds, aggregation, or gates on this result.
